title: Electricians
content:
About the Role
Install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. Ensure that work is in accordance with relevant codes. May install or service street lights, intercom systems, or electrical control systems.
What You'll Do
Prepare sketches or follow blueprints to determine the location of wiring or equipment and ensure conformance to building and safety codes.
Place conduit, pipes, or tubing inside designated partitions, walls, or concealed areas, and pull insulated wires through the conduit.
Work from ladders, scaffolds, or roofs to install, maintain, or repair electrical wiring, equipment, or fixtures.
Use a variety of tools and equipment such as power construction equipment, measuring devices, and testing equipment.
Assemble, install, test, or maintain electrical or electronic wiring, equipment, appliances, apparatus, or fixtures.
Connect wires to circuit breakers, transformers, or other components.
Maintain current electrician's license to meet governmental regulations.
Test electrical systems or continuity of circuits to ensure safety of system.


Tools & Technology
Autodesk AutoCAD (CAD software)
Lighting calculation software (Analytical software)
Microsoft Excel (Spreadsheet software)
Education & Experience
Education: Post-secondary certificate or High school diploma or equivalent
On-the-Job Training: 4 to 10 years
Related Work Experience: 4 years to 6 years
Work Environment
Wear safety equipment
Exposed to hazardous conditions
Importance of being exact or accurate
Health and safety of other workers
